instruction: Using LibreOffice Calc, open the annual enterprise survey file located on the Desktop. Identify the cell with the largest value in column I, set its background to yellow, and save the document.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1)
